critical_blockers.issue: No Login or Registration UI exists in frontend. localStorage token is never populated.
critical_blockers.impact: All authenticated backend endpoints return 401 Unauthorized in production.

critical_blockers.issue: Universal silent mock fallbacks in apiHooks.ts mask 401, 404, 422 errors with static fixtures.
critical_blockers.impact: Users see static demo data; database persistence never functions.

critical_blockers.issue: POST /api/v1/work parameter casing mismatch drops effort to 0.0h and deadline to null.
critical_blockers.impact: Newly created items cannot be tracked with deadlines or remaining effort.

critical_blockers.issue: Effort estimation endpoint sends work_title instead of title, causing HTTP 422 error.
Tracking routes in apiHooks.ts use singular /tracking/session/* instead of plural /tracking/sessions/*.
critical_blockers.impact: HTTP 404 Not Found on all backend stopwatch session API requests.
